description: The cheapest public EV charging in Lithuania for a price class (ac, dc or hpc), in EUR/kWh incl. VAT. Give `city` for the cheapest stations there, or `route` {from, to} for the cheapest stations along a driving route (within 2 km of it). With neither, returns the national ranking of charging networks by price plus the cheapest stations in the country. Each result has a `source_url` to cite.

city.description: City or town in Lithuania, e.g. "Kaunas" (or "Kaune").

power_class.description: Price class: "ac" = AC charging (usually up to 22 kW), "dc" = DC fast charging under 150 kW, "hpc" = high-power DC at 150 kW or more.

route.description: A driving route inside Lithuania. Slower than `city`; rate limited.

from.description: Start: a Lithuanian town or address, e.g. "Vilnius".

to.description: Destination: a Lithuanian town or address, e.g. "Klaipėda".

name: cheapest_charging
title: Cheapest EV charging in Lithuania
